Done. **Selected candidate: `candidate_03`** (viewer: `candidate_03/viewer.html`), a lightweight single-floor source BIM of the supplied plan `1f_view.png`, built from the recovered pixel declaration via `build_plan_bim` + targeted `revise_plan_bim`/`revise_bim` edits.

## What the recovery declaration got right (independently verified)
- **Calibration**: cross-checked against the drawing's own dimension chains (top 5000/4940/1120/3940/10000, left 3940/2060/4000/4120/1940/3940, bottom 5000/3640/4000/720/4000/3580/4060, east 7×2000) — every partition, window and door position agrees within ~2–3 px (0.05–0.07 m). The old "not independently verified" note was superseded.
- **Connectivity**: the open gap x≈698–792 at y957 (PASS_corr_s) was re-verified visually — the vertical corridor and bottom-wing corridor are genuinely one continuous space; the entrance lobby (x1250–1437) correctly has **no** wall at y1052 and merges with the wing corridor.
- **Opening coverage**: all 15 windows and 16 doors in the declaration match cyan ink in the original; no missing or invented openings found. Main door measured at y1138 (kept; the nominal 1600 mm chain value rounds to y1135).

## Errors found and fixed (local revisions, unrelated declarations preserved)
1. **Phantom sliver in mid_office_N** — the recess wall was double-represented (ring at y588 + partition at y582), compiling a 6 px × 5 m tail inside the physical wall. Fixed by aligning the ring recess corners to y582 and trimming `P_corr_south` to x513–695 starting exactly at the ring corner (an earlier attempt overlapping the ring failed compilation, as expected).
2. **P_strip_5** — the declared y775 took the south line of the drawn line pair (profile: full-support lines at y770 and y775); corrected to centreline **y772**, consistent with the uniform 2000 mm office rhythm.

## Result
15 spaces (2 top offices, 7-office strip, 2 middle offices, L-shaped corridor, 2 meeting rooms, corridor/lobby space F1_S13), 96 boundaries, 32 openings (16 doors, 15 windows, 1 full-height passage), source self-consistency **pass**; final overlay and rendered source plan inspected against the original.

## Remaining limitations (recorded in the BIM notes)
- All heights (z=0 floor, 3.0 m ceiling, 2.1 m doors, 0.9/2.7 m windows) are **assumptions** — no elevation exists in the input; height coverage is `no_image_evidence_linked`.
- The recess north edge sits on the wall centreline y582 (~0.13 m shallow vs. the outer face) — an accepted representative-plane regularization.
- Office-strip dividers are drawn as ~5 px line pairs; individual dividers may be ~0.05 m off true centreline. W_N1 mullions unresolved (modelled as one 8 m band). Opening review was visual/dimensional, not an automated mark-by-mark review; drawing fidelity is not certified.
